$schemaComment: MobileSpinRoulette — automatic roulette flow and direct NPC payment rules. See config/README.md.

hudChrome.comment: Table chrome: Exit (+ sound). No in-game Save — backup/restore only via Settings export/import. Session still autosaves to localStorage.

noMoreBets.comment: The short betting vignette always closes automatically.

spin.comment: The wheel starts automatically; the player never operates roulette controls.

pay.comment: One click on a winning NPC completes that customer payment. Clicking a loser applies the Service Score error.

homePresentation.comment: Home screen background / title motion. Allowed ids are the only valid values for Settings → Background animation. Default none = static grid. User choice is stored in local settings (mobilespinroulette.settings.v1). Legacy ids (pixel_drift, scanline, …) map to none via asBackgroundAnimation.

optionNotes.recommended: Full home atmosphere: drifting grid, scanline, glow, pixel dust, entrance, rare title glitch.
optionNotes.c64_parallax: 80s multi-plane parallax: starfield layers + pixel hills + ground strip.
